<!-- pr-reviewer: 90b311fcf2b4a9c7af0a0853d78f98be34301ec6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**, with one hand check noted below.

**What looks good**
- Fixes what #1562 describes. The cause is as the issue says: in the default Model mode a viewport click and the hover never reached `feature_click`, although `feature_click::ask` and `click` already handle the armed row (`feature_click.rs:69-70, 108, 187`). The new `interact::feature_routed` (`interact.rs`) routes both click and hover to `feature_click` in a feature mode or while `wcs_pick::collecting`. Faces, edges and corners now reach the draft. "Gizmo axes" are not a separate pick kind in the row; they are covered by edge and corner picks.
- Picks stay inside the existing command path. The route only chooses which pick rule runs. The draft's Apply still queues the undoable `SetWcs`; no field is written ad hoc and the MCP tool is untouched.
- Ordinary selection is unchanged. With the draft disarmed or paused and `geo_pick` Model, `feature_routed` is false and `pick_model` runs as before. The test checks this at its end (a click after Apply is a whole-model select again). A feature mode behaves as before.
- Decision file `docs/decisions/1562-wcs-pick-route.md` is present and names the dropped alternative. No `PROCESS_VERSION`, snapshot PNG, dependency, or process-file change.
- Files stay under the limit: new test file 125 lines, `egui_app/mod.rs` 390. `interact.rs` was already over 400 (about 1794 before, 1806 after); the growth is 12 lines, not blocking.

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43519382391, main 1dce70b5)
- Quick gate: green, ui suites 65 s, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Linux only; the diff has no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS values, so no local run was owed.

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The new test `an_armed_row_takes_viewport_picks_from_the_default_model_mode` drives `pick_at` and `update_hover` from the default mode and covers face, edge, corner, Apply and the disarmed click. I read it and the route; I did not myself re-run the reported mutation (removing the `collecting` term, or reverting the click routing). By reading, the old `pick_at`/`update_hover` gate on `geo_pick` alone would send those clicks to `pick_model`, so the assertions would fail on the old code.
- Owed, as the PR says: a hand check in the live viewport (real mouse clicks and the drawn hover highlight). The test covers state, not pixels.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
